snippet.title: Como hacer GRATIS tu carta de FC26 #futbol #fc26
snippet.description:
Seguime para mas contenido futbolero!

Te dejo el prompt:

Create a high-quality Ultimate Team style football card using the uploaded face images.

The design, layout, and visual style must adapt dynamically based on the selected card type and inputs.

=== PLAYER INFO ===
Player Name: [WRITE NAME HERE]
Position: [ST / CAM / CM / CB / GK / etc]
Overall Rating (OVR): [NUMBER]
Country: [COUNTRY NAME]
Club: [CLUB NAME or NONE]
Card Type: [TOTW / ICON / HERO / TOTY]

=== VISUAL STYLE RULES ===

If Card Type = Team of the Week (TOTW):
- black and gold color palette
- modern, dynamic lighting
- glossy textures
- official Ultimate Team weekly card style
- The design should be modern with a proposed color scheme
and inclusion of new elements, respecting a design that is interpreted as that
of icons.

If Card Type = ICON:
- white, gold, and cream tones
- elegant and legendary aesthetic
- no club badge (or minimal)
- premium lighting and classic football legend vibe
- The design should be modern with a proposed color scheme
and inclusion of new elements, respecting a design that is interpreted as that
of icons.

If Card Type = HERO:
- bold, vibrant colors
- comic-book inspired style
- stylized lighting
- heroic and energetic visual tone

If Card Type = Team of the Year (TOTY):
- futuristic premium card design
- deep blue, electric blue, gold, and neon accents
- advanced 3D elements integrated into the card frame
- floating geometric shapes and layered textures
- glowing animated-style effects
- luxury metallic finishes
- holographic reflections
- dynamic energy particles around the player
- innovative next-generation Ultimate Team aesthetic
- premium cinematic lighting
- visually stunning and modern design inspired by elite football gaming cards

=== PLAYER RENDER ===
- generate a realistic football player portrait based on the uploaded face
- medium close-up framing
- neutral or confident expression
- wearing a football kit (adapted to club if provided)
- high detail skin texture and lighting

=== CARD ELEMENTS ===
Include:
- Player Name
- Overall Rating (OVR)
- Position
- Country flag
- Club badge (if applicable)
- 6 stats: PAC, SHO, PAS, DRI, DEF, PHY

Stats should look realistic but can be slightly stylized depending on the character.

The flag of the nationality and the colors of the club's
crest must be seen as they are and not be modified. 
Do not add text to the chosen letter design.

=== FINAL OUTPUT ===
The result must look like an official, polished, in-game Ultimate Team card from a modern football video game with highly detailed rendering, premium materials, advanced lighting, and immersive visual effects. Make the final image a PNG with a white background.

snippet.description:
Seguime para mas contenido futbolero!
AYUDAME CON TU FOLLOW!

PROMPT:
En la primera imagen adjunta aparece una figurita del álbum del Mundial 2026. Quiero que hagas una nueva figurita con las siguientes características:

1. Quiero que quites la imagen de Lionel Messi y pongas la imagen de la persona que adjunto en la segunda imagen. Quiero que tenga la camiseta de la Selección Argentina, como la que aparece en la figurita original.
Quiero que la imagen de la persona tenga la textura, sombras, luces y color de la foto original.
2. Quiero que en lugar del nombre Lionel Messi aparezca el nombre: ARIEL ORTEGA
3. Quiero que la parte de fecha de nacimiento, altura y peso aparezca: 04/03/1974 / 1,71m / 65 kg.
4. Quiero que en la parte del equipo aparezca: C.A.RIVER PLATE
5. La imagen debe ser de las mismas medidas que la primer imagen que te adjunto. No debes agregar nada, ni cambiar nada de la misma. Solo realiza los cambios que te pido.
